phases.name: facts
phases.guidance: Both receive the same ordinary task instructions and shared skills; only the declaration handout differs.

phases.name: presentation
phases.guidance: Both receive the supplied declarations and the same plan nodes and dependency edges; only rendering differs. This choice is fixed before the fact comparison.

completion: Both fixed proof regions are complete, all required checks pass, protected inputs are unchanged, and the original patch and native session accounting arrive within 150 seconds. Independent GitHub checking decides acceptance. Partial proofs and late accepted patches remain failed complete attempts.

decisions.2,0: The second condition warrants a transfer comparison on reserved list reversal for this profile; no general improvement is established.
decisions.0,2: Inspect whether the second condition harmed this profile before any adoption; retain all failures.
decisions.2,2: No observed success advantage; compare total work including failures without claiming equal methods in general.
decisions.0,0: Both conditions failed. Inspect actual tactics, checking and delivery before proposing another experiment.
decisions.mixed: Inconclusive with two repetitions. Report the actions and failures; do not rerun slots until success.

decision_key: accepted counts as second condition,first condition, separately for each profile and phase
invalid_execution: The comparison cannot isolate guidance when service failures, collection failures or system sleep disrupt sessions. Retain every original outcome, diagnose the disruption and report the comparison as inconclusive; do not replace failed slots or claim that guidance caused the difference.
transfer: Keep accumulator-based list reversal outside development attempts. Fix transfer conditions and controls before any transfer call; do not tune on the transfer result.
backtracking: Only propose a separate controlled test if records show repeated failed paths or inability to return to an earlier valid draft. No state deduplication by printed goals.
publication: Submitted patches and reviewed summaries only; raw local CLI records stay private. Preserve all twenty slots, every timeout and all earlier evidence.
resource_observer: A low-priority observer outside the throttled workload measures the required guard, controller, CLI and workers together. All actual work remains inside fr-local-guard.py. Keep the same wall/CPU/RSS/disk/output limits; a stopped or missing complete-attempt receipt cannot pass.
task_import: Fresh cohort uses import Init with the same executable GCD and claims. Preserve the earlier full-Std cohort separately; do not compare its timing or memory directly.
